title: Nocturne for Absent Things
note: Orchestral nocturne written in MuseScore for the novel. Released on Spotify via RouteNote on 2026-08-12 as Augustas Armalis. The file is the 44.1 kHz export from 2026-08-13, which is most likely the released version with the rewritten opening. The 'OG' export from 2026-08-12 is left out. The cover is assumed from IMG_3199 (same date).

title: Afterlight
note: The novel's ending piece, in the style of On the Nature of Daylight. The score is credited to Augustas Armalis, with the working title 'Žiemos Naktys Šviesesnės — The Ending' / 'When Winter Learned to Glow'. Polished in MuseScore on 2026-10-15, B♭ minor to D♭ major, ♩=60. It started from an AI-assisted coda session in August and is unreleased, so he needs to confirm that it's his and that it's shareable. Re-encoded from 320 kbps MP3 to 160 kbps AAC to save space. The cover comes from coverr.png (same date).
